items.distractor_fact: Термометр в соседнем посёлке тем же утром показывал {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: The thermometer in the neighboring village showed {D} °C that same morning.
items.entity_note: a different village's own thermometer, not the balcony thermometer whose evening/morning readings the question compares

items.distractor_fact: Акции другой компании на той же бирже в тот день стоили {D} $.
items.gloss_en: Shares of a different company on the same exchange were worth {D} $ that day.
items.entity_note: a different company's shares, not the one whose opening/closing price is compared

items.distractor_fact: На соседнем маршруте другой альпинист поднялся на высоту {D} м.
items.gloss_en: On a neighboring route, a different climber ascended to an altitude of {D} m.
items.entity_note: a different climber on a different route, not the one whose start/end altitudes are compared

items.distractor_fact: Вес другого спортсмена в той же группе составлял {D} кг.
items.gloss_en: The weight of a different athlete in the same group was {D} kg.
items.entity_note: a different athlete's weight, not the one whose before/after weights are compared

items.distractor_fact: У другого участника той же гонки радар зафиксировал скорость {D} км/ч.
items.gloss_en: For a different competitor in the same race, the radar recorded a speed of {D} km/h.
items.entity_note: a different competitor's recorded speed, not the finish/previous-section readings for this racer

items.distractor_fact: На отдельном счёте того же банка за тот же месяц было внесено {D} $.
items.gloss_en: On a separate account at the same bank, {D} $ was deposited that same month.
items.entity_note: a different account's deposit, not this account's deposited/withdrawn figures

items.distractor_fact: Расходы соседней семьи за тот же месяц составили {D} $.
items.gloss_en: A neighboring family's expenses for that same month amounted to {D} $.
items.entity_note: a different family's expenses, not this family's income/expenses

items.distractor_fact: Другой клуб того же дивизиона забил за сезон {D}.
items.gloss_en: A different club in the same division scored {D} over the season.
items.entity_note: a different club's goals scored, not this club's scored/conceded difference

items.distractor_fact: На другом поле в тот же день число ударов другого игрока равнялось {D}.
items.gloss_en: On a different course that same day, another player's stroke count equaled {D}.
items.entity_note: a different course and player whose own par is not stated, so it cannot pair with this course's par

items.distractor_fact: На соседнем маршруте фактическое время прибытия другого поезда соответствовало отметке {D} мин от полуночи.
items.gloss_en: On a neighboring route, another train's actual arrival time corresponded to a mark of {D} minutes from midnight.
items.entity_note: a different train on a different route, with its own unstated schedule, not this train's actual-vs-scheduled comparison

items.distractor_fact: В другом матче того же тура одна из команд забила {D}.
items.gloss_en: In a different match of the same round, one of the teams scored {D}.
items.entity_note: goals from an unrelated match, not the home/away teams the question compares

items.distractor_fact: В этом же забеге результат бегуна Сидорова составил {D}.
items.gloss_en: In this same race, runner Sidorov's result was {D}.
items.entity_note: a third runner's result, not Ivanov's or Petrov's, whose gap the question asks about

items.distractor_fact: В этой же группе результат студентки Соколовой на экзамене составил {D}.
items.gloss_en: In this same group, student Sokolova's result on the exam was {D}.
items.entity_note: a third student's result, not Kovalyova's or Morozova's, whose difference the question asks about
